headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 8, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants, securing a 10-0 victory. Kazuma Okamoto led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. The Chicago Cubs secured a 9-7 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, led by Pete Crow-Armstrong's 2 home runs and 2 RBIs. The Detroit Tigers secured a 6-1 victory over the Athletics, with Spencer Torkelson hitting a home run and driving in three.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. The San Diego Padres placed Samad Taylor on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins placed Marco Raya on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 5, 2026, due to a right shoulder impingement. The Pittsburgh Pirates placed Endy Rodríguez on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 6, 2026, due to a left glute strain. The Philadelphia Phillies placed Lou Trivino III on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 7, 2026, due to a right thoracic muscle spasm. The San Francisco Giants placed Jonah Cox on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 6, 2026, due to a left oblique strain. The New York Mets placed Austin Warren on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm strain. The Minnesota Twins placed Byron Buxton on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 6, 2026, due to a right hip strain. The Pittsburgh Pirates placed Konnor Griffin on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 6, 2026, due to a left ring finger sagittal back injury.

The New York Mets acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash. The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash. The Houston Astros traded LHP Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.
